programme.title: Библия. Синодальный и церковно-славянский переводы
programme.desc: Многосерийный фильм «Библия». Библия на Руси появилась позже, чем в других странах, но все же уже существовала на местном языке задолго до появления Синодального перевода. Это был церковнославянский перевод Священного Писания. Какова роль Синодального и церковнославянского переводов Библии? История Российского Библейского общества. Ведущий: Анатолий Руденко, исполнительный директор РБО, Гость: И. Лобанов, ведущий научный сотрудник Института перевода Библии им. М. П.Кулакова, А. Синицын, магистр в области религии, священнослужитель, А. Десницкий, доктор филологических наук, профессор РАН, Н. Гузов

programme.title: Что есть Евангелие? Как в религиозной жизни избежать крайностей
programme.desc: Религиозный фанатизм начинается там, где человек уверен, что абсолютно прав. Почему Христу сначала стелили пальмовые ветви, а потом распяли? Почему те, кто ещё вчера славил апостола Павла, сегодня готовы побить его камнями? Как не впасть в подобные крайности и оставаться ведомым не эмоциями, а Святым Духом? Как распознать Божью волю и не превратить веру в опасную религию? Ведущий: Юлия Уткина, Гость: Николай Кунцевич, священнослужитель и Елена Варнавская

programme.title: Возрождение. Дух Святой меняет нас
programme.desc: Никто не может стать настолько порочным или пасть так низко, чтобы сила Святого Духа не могла в нем произвести свою очистительную работу. В каждом, кто отдаст себя Святому духу, будет утвержден новый принцип жизни, будет восстановлен утраченный образ жизни. Сегодня мы можем стать другими людьми. У кого нет любви – Бог сделает самыми любящими. Робщущих и унылых – благодарными и радостными. Робких – общительными. Тех, кому трудно освободиться от гнева, раздражительности, критики – сделать людьми истинно свободными. Ведущий: Владимир Котов, священнослужитель

programme.desc: Здоровые руки – важное условие для полноценной жизни человека, потому что от рук зависит его возможности в повседневной и профессиональной деятельности. programme.desc: Обыкновенная каша в необычном исполнении: гречневая каша с пророщенной чечевицей. А в дополнение к ней предлагаем подать овощной торт. Морская капуста с маринованным луком и льняным маслом – удачный вариант замены селедки в популярной «шубе». Ведущий: Ангелина Дубровина

programme.title: Открытая Книга. Весть трёх ангелов в конце мировой истории
programme.desc: Что такое вечное Евангелие? Почему пал Вавилон? И что представляет собой начертание зверя и вино ярости Божьей? В книге Откровение описана весть трёх ангелов, в которой и упоминаются все эти понятия. В чём заключается трёхангельская весть и каково её значение в нашей жизни? Ведущий: Юлия Синицына, Гость: Андрей Юнак, священнослужитель

programme.title: Где сейчас Бог? Число запечатлённых. 144 тысячи из книги «Откровение» – кто эти люди?
programme.desc: В одном из видений апостола Иоанна, записанных в книге Откровение, говорится о 144 тысячах людей, искупленных от земли. Что это за люди и почему их столько? Что они будут делать? Ведущий: Юлия Уткина, Гость: Александр Камнев, пресвитер церкви и Елена Варнавская

programme.title: Библия 21-го века. Послание Иакова, 4 глава. Всё под контролем!
programme.desc: В желании все контролировать мы забываем, что этот мир принадлежит Богу. Проблема автономии от Бога в том, что планы человека могут неожиданно рухнуть. Залог успешного планирования – делать это вместе с Богом. Ведущий: Мария Мараханова, Гость: Михаил Долженко, священнослужитель

programme.title: Библейские истории. Иаков борется с Богом
ВкусСнятоВо. Три удовольствия
programme.desc: Эта детская кулинарная программа рассказывает о трёх удовольствиях. Первое удовольствие – это угощение, второе удовольствие – это его приготовление, а о третьем удовольствии можно будет узнать, отгадав загадку в конце программы. А еще каждый из участников программы поделится секретом приготовления какого-то простого угощения. Ведущий: Алексей Ронжин, Самуил Сергеев, Надя Малышева

programme.title: Просто о сложном. Зачем нужна мораль?
programme.desc: Зачем нам мораль? Кто придумал моральные нормы? Откуда мы узнаем, что хорошо, а что – плохо? Ведущий: Антон Бойков, священнослужитель

programme.title: Пит Стоп. Я не хочу взрослеть
programme.desc: Почему некоторые молодые люди не хотят взрослеть, проявляют инфантильные качества? Что значит – быть взрослым? Какие преимущества дает взрослость? Как повзрослеть и получать радость от того, что ты несешь ответственность за свою жизнь? Ведущий: Сергей Парфенов, Наталья Булатова, Богдан Павлюк, Надежда Малышева

programme.title: Жизнь с Богом. Можно ли слишком далеко уйти от Бога?
programme.desc: «В любой момент я смогу покаяться, и Бог простит», – так думают некоторые, но иногда события в жизни разворачиваются так стремительно, что мы не успеваем покаяться. История из пятой главы книги пророка Даниила описывает случай, произошедший с царем Валтасаром. Во время роскошного пира перед царём и вельможами возникла рука, которая писала на стене слова. Что это были за слова, кто смог из истолковать и чем закончилась для царя эта история? В чём нужно было покаяться Валтасару? Почему важно не откладывать своё покаяние? Ведущий: Роман Кисаков, священнослужитель, молодежный лидер

programme.title: Вопрос ребром. Как поддержать во время трудностей?
programme.desc: Нередко жизнь подкидывает нам неприятные сюрпризы. Удачные периоды сменяются трудностями. Не всегда мы можем справиться со сложностями в одиночку. В такие моменты мы нуждаемся в поддержке близких, друзей, родных. Как правильно поддержать человека в непростой для него период? Ведущий: Вилина Парфенова

programme.desc: Ведущий: Радмила Спивак

programme.title: Возрождение. Верность Богу – мелочь ли это?
programme.desc: Важны ли для Бога мелочи? Почему за некоторые дела Бог строго наказывал людей? Неужели Бог – мстительный и мелочный? Например, царь Саул принес жертву сам, не дождавшись пророка Самуила, и Бог за это лишил его трона. Почему? Это было так важно? В чем был виноват Саул? Самсон также проявлял своеволие. Как Бог отнесся к его непослушанию? Ведущий: Олег Харламов, священнослужитель

programme.title: Контрасты души. Перфекционизм – страсть к совершенству
programme.desc: Многие люди хотя бы раз в жизни сталкивались с перфекционистом – человеком, который стремится абсолютно любое дело сделать идеально, совершенно и даже не начинает никакого дела, если видит для этого препятствия. Что такое страсть к совершенству, чем она грозит и кто такие перфекционисты? Перфекционизм – хорошая черта характера или с ней стоит бороться? На вопросы отвечает гость программы психолог-консультант Василий Половинко. Ведущий: Игорь Кириченко, Гость: Василий Половинко, психолог-консультант, священнослужитель

programme.title: В гостях у ТРК «Три Ангела». Я пришла к Богу, ничего не потеряв
programme.desc: Идти к Богу – значит меняться и приводить свою жизнь в соответствие Божьим требованиям. Маргарита шла к Богу, но боялась перемен, боялась, что придется от многого отказаться и многим пожертвовать. Но в итоге с Богом она только приобретала и ничего не теряла. Ведущий: Юлия Синицына, Гость: Маргарита Колываенко

programme.title: Если бы любовь… Он и она в книге «Песнь Песней» (первая часть)
programme.desc: В книге Песнь Песней описана чувственная любовь и сексуальные отношения мужчины и женщины. Почему библейская книга воспевает физическую любовь? Почему эта книга помещена в библейский канон и считается богодухновенной наряду с пророчествами и посланиями апостолов? Бог сотворил человека с сексуальными желаниями. Как правильно выражать их и использовать дар сексуальности? Как понимать друг друга? Ведущий: Виталий Олийник, руководитель Центра духовного просвещения

programme.title: Принято считать. Как раскрыть в себе женственность
programme.desc: Время обратиться к своей природе! Женщинам так важно вернуть свою плавность, нежность, женственность. Такая женщина получает все дары жизни как бы само собой, мужчины любят её, всё вокруг радует. Бегать, суетиться, напрягаться, зарабатывать, переживать – это всё не женское. Как же стать такой? Как вернуть себе женственность в суете города? Ведущий: Юлия Синицына, Гость: Айгуль Иншакова, психолог

programme.title: Загадки древних рукописей. Тайна страстной субботы и Евангелие от Никодима
programme.desc: Каждый человек рано или поздно сталкивается со смертью. В Библии мы находим тексты, говорящие об этом явлении. Как их понимать? Существует также книга, не вошедшая в Библию – Евангелие от Никодима. О какой темнице и каком свете там говорится? Что в Священном Писании говорится о смерти, загробной жизни и чистилище? И какого мнения стоит придерживаться нам? Ведущий: Олег Габрусевич, историк, богослов, Гость: Александр Богданенков, филолог, литературовед, богослов

programme.title: Познавая истину. Что ты выберешь?

programme.desc: Человек очень сильно прилепляется к тому, над чем много трудился. Все богатство в глазах Бога ничего не значит, его не возьмешь в вечную жизнь. Бог воздаст за каждую несправедливость. Ведущий: Мария Мараханова, Гость: Михаил Долженко, священнослужитель

programme.title: Веселая школа здоровья. Про одежду для детей
programme.desc: Почему родители просят своих детей одеться потеплее? Зачем в каждом доме есть градусники? Как они помогают быть здоровыми? Об этом узнают дошкольники из данной программы. Ведущий: Михаил Севастьянов, Татьяна Малышева, Гость: Настя Сажина, Матвей Сергеев

programme.title: Лица времени. По примеру Отца… (вторая серия)
programme.desc: Есть люди, которые при жизни горят, как звезды, а когда они уходят, то оставляют теплый след в сердцах людей, с которыми они соприкасались. Таким человеком был Дмитрий Онисимович Юнак, который строил свою жизнь на библейском основании. Во второй серии фильма «По примеру Отца» вы узнаете, что значила молитва в жизни Д. Юнака, как Бог отвечал на его молитвы, об уникальном явлении переложения всей Библии на стихи, о том как Дмитрий Онисимович участвовал в библейском образовании молодежи с помощью ребусов и кроссвордов. Ведущий: Ирина Кириченко, Гость: Д. Юнак, пастор, историк церкви, В. Юнак пастор, А. Юнак, пастор, П. Гончар, пастор, Н. Подчуфарова, учитель музыки, В. Костев, пастор, А. Гладков, пастор

programme.desc: Вашему малышу пошел уже второй год. В этом возрасте все дети осваивают навыки свободного передвижения. Ребенок становится более самостоятельным. Но самое приятное для родителей, что теперь его можно кормить самой разнообразной пищей. С развитием жевательных навыков и появлением зубов родители вводят в меню ребенка более твердую пищу, много фруктов и овощей и даже первые десерты. Но какие ошибки могут допустить родители в этот период? Ведущий: Анастасия Сергеева, Гость: Наталья Анатольевна Драч, врач-педиатр

programme.title: Открытая Книга. Чему не должен радоваться христианин?
programme.desc: Иисус отправил 70 учеников в первое миссионерское путешествие. Те вернулись, радуясь тому, что бесы им повинуются, и они могут творить именем Христа разные чудеса. Но Иисус велел им не радоваться способностям творить чудеса, и четко сказал, чему именно следует радоваться, когда проповедуешь Евангелие. Мы разбираем эту историю, записанную в 10 главе Евангелия от Луки. Ведущий: Юлия Синицына, Гость: Сергей Долматов, священнослужитель

programme.desc: Иисус Христос однажды рассказал Своим ученикам притчу о неверном управителе. Эта притча в каком-то смысле параллельна истории об Иосифе, который, будучи рабом, тоже был управителем в доме египтянина. Чему нас учат эти истории об управителях? К чему лучше стремиться: к земному или вечному небесному благополучию? Ведущий: Андрей Юнак, священнослужитель

programme.desc: Видов зависимости очень много, но все они в основе имеют один и тот же механизм. Поэтому нет смысла избавляться от одной зависимости, чтобы сразу попасть в другую. Надо бороться со своей зависимостью экологичными методами. НО них расскажет Алексей Дымов, руководитель фонда социальной помощи. Ведущий: Алексей Дымов, председатель фонда социальной помощи

А также поделится советами и предостережениями с теми, кто хочет попробовать найти свою судьбу в сети. Ведущий: Размик Меликбекян, Борис Звездилин, Гость: Татьяна Харибина

programme.title: Возрождение. Непредсказуемый Бог
programme.desc: Предсказуемы ли действия Бога? Всегда ли Бог действует так, как мы ожидаем? Бог призывает человека сделать выбор. Например, Бог призвал Авраама принести его сына Исаака принести в жертву. Почему Бог призвал Авраама к этому? Почему Христос допустил бурю на море, когда Его ученики ловили рыбу? Мы привыкли к предсказуемости, а Бог иногда действует непривычно для нас. Почему? Чем отличается поклонение Богу от поклонения идолу? Ведущий: Вячеслав Бучнев, священнослужитель

Как сатана действует в нашей жизни и как от него уберечься? Есть ли у него права вторгаться в нашу жизнь? Ведущий: Валерий Малышев, Гость: Павел Гончар, священнослужитель, магистр богословия

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.desc: Alaska - the largest and at the same time most sparsely populated state in the USA. Only about 740,000 people live here. Often far away in small villages. Almost every village has its own airstrip. Aircrafts are one of the main means of transport in Alaska. Jamie Klaes is one of the many female pilots in the country.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.desc: Living conditions are harsh in the Australian outback, especially in William Creek. Only 17 people live here, and in summer even less - only two. There is a motel, a campsite, a pub and the only petrol station in a radius of hundreds of miles. The young bush pilot Hannah Jane Cash lives and works here.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.desc: Alia Twal is an enthusiastic pilot, globetrotter and adventurer. She is a first officer with the Jordanian airline Royal Jordanian and flies large passenger planes. She climbs the highest mountains in the world, dives with sharks or goes skydiving. Alia particularly enjoys travelling in her Jordanian homeland.

programme.title: Menorca - Majorca's beautiful sister
programme.desc: Not nearly as crowded as Majorca or Ibiza: Menorca has noticeably fewer visitors than her sister islands and in 1993, was recognised by UNESCO as a biosphere re-serve. Menorca also has its own distinctive charm, with its secluded coves, mighty cliffs, beautiful gardens and ages old towns and villages. Its residents love the is-lands treasures and peculiarities. Forests make up al-most a third of Menorca, complemented by many lush green meadows. Next to tourism, agriculture is a major source of the island's income to the present day. On Menorca, there are several accumulations of enormous megalithic stones. From a global point of view, the up to five-metre-tall "Taulas", whereby the stones are ar-ranged in the shape of a "T", are unique.

programme.title: mareTV: Tenerife - The Queen of the Canaries
programme.desc: Tenerife is outstanding among the Canary Islands. If only because of the volcano Pico del Teide, which rises exactly 3.718 meters above sea level and is thus the highest mountain in Spain. But not only scenically Tenerife, the largest of the Canary Islands, stands out...

programme.title: The Heart of Hawaii - The Island of Oahu
programme.desc: The Oahu island is the economic and cultural centre of the Hawaiian archipelago, as well as being a paradise for surfers, active holidaymakers and freedom lovers. The island is home to more than half of all natives and almost eight million foreign guests annually. Anyone searching for peace and seclusion won’t find either in Honolulu or Waikiki. Traffic congestion and a backdrop of skyscrapers belong to the town panorama. Hip cafes, galleries and young fashion firms have settled here, adding a new and modern flair to the capital. Cindy’s Lei Shoppe, the Chinatown florists, has been here for more than 30 years. This is also because the so-called Leis, the tradition of floral decoration, usually offered as a flower necklace or as a headdress, is still an important part of Hawaiian culture. Keone Nunes is well-known for his traditional tattooing skills, whereby the so-called Kakau Tattoos are virtually hammered into the skin with a hippo tooth. But Oahu is also an island of overwhelming natural beauty and a fascinating diversity on the smallest of places ...

programme.title: Dream Islands Of Europe: Capri, Ischia and Procida
programme.desc: Capri and Ischia are world famous. From Naples, it's just a short hop over to the two islands. Perfect destinations, then, for a week's cruise along the Gulf of Naples and the adjoining Amalfi Coast to the south. There, Positano, Amalfi or Salerno as well as a handful of other mostly small harbor towns are extremely worthwhile destinations.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: We travel from Georgia through the Carolinas to Virginia, ending near Washington, DC. Along the way we meet a Georgia farmer; talk to painter J. Chris Wilson in Charleston; sail along the Outer Banks of Carolina, and visit rural Virginia, experiencing life in the beautiful southern states.

programme.title: mareTV: Ibiza - Island of Light
programme.desc: The light of the Balearic island of Ibiza is magical and its trademark: The "Island of Light" is tiny compared to its sister island Mallorca, but offers the most beautiful sunsets in the world. That's what they say. They attract sun worshippers and party people from near and far. To the sounds of the famous "Balearic Sound" they turn night into day. This documentary documents the island in the balancing act between luxury yachts and traditions. Hippie culture, celebrities, pine forests, bays with turquoise water and villages with bright white houses: Ibiza has many faces. Mora (80) and Djin (67) have been drawn to the island for 55 years. They are the uncrowned kings of the hippies. But only love, light, air and laziness, these times are also long gone on Ibiza. Mora knits sexy jerseys for young hippies from morning till night. Djin helps her sell at the famous Las Dalias hippie market and works as a construction worker: chilling and no pension in sight. The virgin Carmen is the patron saint of the sailors. On her day of honour, a mass is celebrated in the port city of Eivissa. Afterwards, fishermen carry the Virgin through the narrow streets of Ibiza City down to the quay. And then Carmen sets sail. Several places on Ibiza claim to offer the most beautiful sunset in the world: In front of Cala de Benirrás, the sun sinks right next to the iconic rock Cap Benat, which the locals awefully call "God's Finger". The typical soft beats over the sea sound from almost all the bays and provide deep relaxation worldwide under the term "Balearic Sound". Some of the famous DJs are jetting around the globe for huge fees. But in the small beach bars, the Chiringuitos, the island sound is celebrated further. On the beach of Cala Salada the Brit Joe Burnley has the command over a troop of mermaids. The ladies squeeze into the tight mermaid costume for the good cause. With great grace they swim towards yachts that are forbidden to anchor on sea grass meadows. Charming but unyielding, they point out the offence to the captain and crew; a creative environmental action to save the endangered Neptune gas, green lung of the sea and habitat for Ibiza's seahorses. The underwater photographer Manu San Felix is also committed to the endangered seahorses. Using a probe, he maps the coastal area around Ibiza and feeds the data into a GPS app. No skipper should be able to say that he didn't even know that his anchor was clawing into Neptune grass. On land, Manu is dedicated to breeding seahorses. His plan: He wants to expose the animals in the Mediterranean to Ibiza and Formentera in order to secure their population. Garages on the beach? Many bays on the island still have Casetas Varadero, boat garages threatened with decay. Fishermen once built them illegally. The picturesque sheds are therefore only tolerated, but may no longer be restored. The 83-year-old Toni Salvado still drives straight out to sea from his garage. He fishes for his own needs and a few friends, he is not allowed to sell his catch.

programme.title: In the Heart of Scotland - By Train trough the Lowlands
programme.desc: The first part of this journey through Scotland begins in the colourful and vibrant capital, Edinburgh. It takes us through the rolling hills of the Scottish Lowlands, en route to the wild, picturesque east coast and Aberdeen. There are new and exciting views behind every bend: heath-covered hills with a magically purple glow, beautiful lakes and forests of the deepest shades of green. The breath-taking camerawork for this documentary received the Columbus Film Award.

programme.title: mareTV: The white wilderness in Greenland's East
programme.desc: Fjords, glaciers and the highest mountains in the Arctic: East Greenland with its spectacular nature is one of the most sparsely populated regions on earth. The people here live in extreme isolation and depend on helicopter flights for their supplies. Despite harsh conditions, the inhabitants here lovingly maintain their traditions and enjoy their outdoor leisure time even at minus 20 degrees Celsius. The town of Tasiilaq is the "metropolis" with 4,000 inhabitants and offers a very special attraction: the only ski lift on the east coast. Thomas Mikaelsen, the lift attendant, is not to be envied for his job. The only 100 meter long lift comes from Switzerland and is already 20 years old. If Thomas gets the drag lift running at all, it often only lasts for an hour. Then the ski crazy's luck depends on his repair skills. The lift is the only frosty open-air pleasure. For Salo Kunuk his sled dogs are both pleasure and work. He is currently teaching his daughter Karla how to steer a dog sled, private driving lessons from her father, so to speak. Karla will need it, because in the eternal ice the sled is the only means of transportation.

programme.title: Lunenburg: Where the Land Meets the Sea
programme.desc: On the east coast of Canada, a place whose name sounds strangely familiar. The small town of Lunenburg, west of Halifax, was founded in 1753 by North German immigrants. Today, the idyllic town with its many wooden houses is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the 19th century, Lunenburg was one of the richest towns in the British Empire, becoming prosperous through fishing and shipbuilding. Glenn Rhodenizer's family traces back ten generations directly to German immigrants. And what the Rhodenizers primarily grow on their fields directly by the sea could hardly be more typical: it is white cabbage, which the farming family processes into sauerkraut. Sauerkraut can be found in every restaurant and supermarket in this area; it is the specialty of the region. The heritage of wooden boat building is successfully maintained by David Westergard. In his ancient shed, he is assembling a 20-meter schooner from four different types of local wood. Building wooden boats, he says, is like "slow food": sustainable, conscious, environmentally friendly, waste-free.

programme.title: mareTV: Denmarks Limfjord - From Sea to Sea
programme.desc: Wide open spaces, water, meadows: The Limfjord stretches through Jutland in Denmark in countless bays, canals and sounds. Mighty water castles, country palaces and magnificent monasteries are enthroned on its shores. It is a rather lonely area, even in high summer it is quiet. This is probably why the people here are so friendly and sociable. Birte, Silla and Bo cycle to their fjord garden project in the harbor of the town of Løgstør to harvest mussels, oysters and seaweed. They think gardening is best in a club. Luckily, Silla, a resourceful tinkerer, has just made another ingenious invention: the mussel washing machine. Cruising the narrow Næssund, a branch of the Limfjord, is the Næssund Ferry, the smallest and oldest car ferry in the area. New on board, and the first and only woman on this ship, is deckhand Lilian Kohler. She is "girl for everything", but wants more, because Lilian is a trained navigator. She is magically drawn to the bridge, but the old captain doesn't think much of retiring ashore.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In Bangladesh, the land with the highest density of population in the world (and the highest amount of corruption), the daily struggle to survive is fought everywhere, including the streets. Nowhere do people drive as brutally and recklessly as here. In Bangladesh you drive on the road like others drive with a bumper car: if you need space, you simply ram the car driving next to you. The police only came if there are fatalities. The biggest bottleneck in the transport system is the historical old town of Dhaka. Old Dhaka is a universe of its own, a world of bazaars in which every trade has its own quarter: there are streets of jewelers, sweets makers and fashionable tailors, and the vegetable wholesalers have their warehouses down at the port. The deliveries take place mostly on the river, the Buriganga River, a stinking cesspool. But the sold goods usually leave by land, and the customers also come by the land route – the Nawabpur Road. They generally come in buses or by rickshaw, where too many people are crammed into too little space. The traffic in Dhaka is everyday, normal madness. The film accompanies a rickshaw, a bus and a truck on their dangerous way through the streets of Dhaka and shows how it is possible to survive in what seems to be an incontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: They run through deserts, through ice and snow, deep into the jungle, along the water and over the mountains. The landscapes through which these routes wind are unique and exert their never-ending fascination even on regular travellers. In our documentary “Hot Roads – An Icebound Road” which is part of the five-part film series “Hot Roads” we want to tell the stories that take place along the route itself, of the people who live along it and for whom the road is part and parcel of their personal destiny.

programme.title: mareTV: Estonia's Enchanted Islands - Kihnu, Hiiumaa, Saaremaa & Co
programme.desc: Kihnu is one of 19 inhabited Estonian islands. When the women there ride motorcycles in colourful skirts, it is summer. Thanks to its remoteness, charming traditions have been preserved here. More than 2,000 islands belong to Estonia, none is like the other, each with its own character. Most of them were military restricted areas during the Soviet Union. Of all things, the strict shielding had its good points: beach, forest, juniper groves, they still characterise the landscape of Estonia's enchanted islands. Elly Karjam is a "multi-jobber": lighthouse keeper, ice-cream producer and contract knitter for the famous Kihnu sweaters. Summer is high season for her: She is expecting guests from the USA, who had their ancestors on Kihnu. Birches have to be cut for the so-called viht. This bunch of birch branches is an important accessory for the traditional sauna at midsummer. And the motorcycles in the shed are to be refloated.

programme.title: The Provence coast - Marseille and the Côte Bleue
programme.desc: The Provence is famed for its endless fields of laven-der, but this lush landscape also has a beautifully mari-time touch: The Côte Bleue! Small, hidden beaches, charming harbour towns, imposing, craggy bays and a uniquely clear light that has attracted painters includ-ing Cézanne and Braque. The coast derives its name from the deep blue water and extends from Marseille to Martigues. This small town is also known as "The Ven-ice of the North", as it is shaped entirely by water: an inland lake, the sea itself, as well as a connecting canal. In the bays of the Calanques, the steeply-walled coastal inlets in the Mediterranean limestone, Lionel Franc is a cliff diver. His personal record is a hight of 36 metres! Ambi is a sculptress. This young artist's work, who moved to Marseille from Madagascar many years ago, is characterised by a dynamic momentum. As a pas-sionate pétanque player, she demonstrates this drive on the boules courts of the port city. John Pendray is Pein-tre officiel de la Marine, an official marine painter. The French state allows just 40 painters to its circle. There are no monetary rewards, but heaps of honour and a very smart uniform!

programme.title: mareTV: Venice - Lagoon and Legend
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very attached to their traditional cuisine. The island of Sant' Erasmo is the town's garden. Artichokes, radicchio, onions, everything that grows here is said to taste fantastic, thanks to the salt content of the air and water. Carlo and Claudio Finotello not only grow the vegetables, they even deliver directly to their customers' doors. At sunset, they sail through the lagoon with their boat, brimming with produce, towards San Marco. People waiting at the many bridges, now receive their wares: regional, seasonal, fresh. And without a hint of stress if possible. Like so many other things in Venice. Perhaps because La Serenissima is also known as "The Composed".

programme.title: Germany's Wild Amazon
programme.desc: As one of Germany’s beauties, the river was the gem of Germanys landscape. But with industrialization it became the country’s hardest working river and like everything that has been overworked, it lost it magnificence and charm. Due to tender love and care, the river is now a reigning example of one of the most successful and outstanding renaturation projects in the country.The film shows never before seen shots of the river now pulsing with life. We will show you the winding river bed, spawning salmon, mating crabs and still-growing anchor ice. You will see dipper birds searching for food under water, kingfishers catching fish, a family life of badgers, foxes and a wide variety of birds. Come and meet the resurrected river Wupper!

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Sand! Sea! Worms! Stan and Gran must quickly discover where all these worms came from or Ellie's new clothes drying service will be ruined! Gainmheach! Muir! Boiteagan! Feumaidh Dan is Gran co-dhùnadh gu luath, cò às a thàinig na tha seo de bhoiteagan, no thèid an t-seirbheis ùr 'son tioramachadh aodaich aig Eilidh, à bith!

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Sgeadaichte ann an deiseachan-fànais, coisichidh Sif, Pipp agus Bran air a’ ghealaich! Ziff, Pipp, and Button don their spacesuits to become the first frogs to walk on the moon!

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha Meanbh Chlangair air fonn mìorbhaileach eile a chruthachadh ‘s tha i am beachd a shealltainn do Bheag aig na craobhan ciùil. Gu mi-fhortanach, tha gaoth mhòr ri tighinn ‘s tha na leadanan a’ falbh leis a’ ghaoith. Feumar an lorg! Meanbh has created another melody and she wants to show it to Beag at the music trees. Unfortunately, a big gust arrives and the notes disappear with the wind. They must be found!

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha Moo Adhair a' toirt pìos meatailt do Bheag. Chan eil fhios aig duine dè th’ ann ach tha a’ Chearc Iarainn toilichte an rud a chumail. Gu mì-fhortanach, tha aice ri thilleadh nuair a tha Beag a' tuigsinn dè th’ ann. Moo Adhair gives Beag a piece of metal. Nobody knows what it is, but Cearc Iarainn wants to keep it. Unfortunately, she has to return it when Beag realises what it is.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Catriona Nic a’ Phì a’ leughadh An Cù-chaorach Iongantach. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Pinny Grylls agus a dhealbhachadh le Rosie Wellesley. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Dòmhnall Iain MacLeòid. A bedtime story for young children. Catriona MacPhee reads An Cù-chaorach Iongantach by Pinny Grylls, illustrated by Rosie Wellesley and translated into Gaelic by Donald John MacLeod.

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: Seach g’ eil Aileas a’ faireachdainn gu math a-nis às dèidh tinneas, tha i airson tilleadh gu beatha àbhaisteach. Le sin, tha i dol a ghabhail pàirt ann an cùrsa dùbhlanach a ghabhas àite aig deireadh an t-samhraidh. As Aileas has recovered from her illness, she would like to return to a normal life. To this end, she is going to take part in an obstacle course in the summer.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Nuair tha Elaina airson Fasgadh a’ Bhogha Mhòir a leagail, tha Sebastian cho troimh-chèile. Ach, le taic bho Adele is Belle, tha gnothaichean air an socrachadh! When Elaina wants to bulldoze the Great Bow shelter, Sebastian is very upset. With help from Adele and Belle, things are sorted out!

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha Seonaidh a' tighinn tarsainn air pìos mìrean-measgaichte a bha air chall agus tha a' sireadh taic bhon treud airson a chuir ri chèile. Nuair a tha Bitzer a' mothachadh gu bheil am pìos mu dheireadh air chall tha aca ri rud sam bith a dhèanamh gus a' mhìrean-measgaichte a chrìochnachadh. Shaun comes across a discarded jigsaw puzzle and calls on the flock to help him put it together. When Bitzer discovers the final piece is missing, they decide to do whatever it takes to solve the puzzle.

programme.title: A’ Chùil
programme.desc: Tha Choirstaidh air ais le prògram eile bhon stiùidio aice, A’ Chùil. Anns a’ phrògram seo tha i a’ sealltainn dhut mar a nì thu pù agus speuclairean fuadain. A bharrachd air a sin, seallaidh I dhut mar a nì thu dealbh sgoinneil dhe do shùilean. Choirstaidh shows you how to make pretend poo and fake glasses. She also gives you a few pointers on how to draw a great picture of eyes.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Tha a h-uile duine a' gabhail fadachd ri rèis mhòr nan tidseir. Ach cò nì a’ chùis air a’ chùrsa aig Mrs Fullerton? Tha aon rud cinnteach, chan eil fhios aig duine sam bith dè dh’fhaodadh tachairt san rèis seo! Everyone is looking forward to the teachers’ big race. Who will triumph over Mrs Fullerton’s course? One thing is sure, nobody knows what's going to happen!

programme.title: Fuine
programme.desc: Gregor MacLeod and fellow islanders share baking tips. Featuring haggis in crispy filo bon bon parcels and a cheesecake using caramel flavoured biscuits.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop gar toirt tron tuilleadh cheumannan gus Gàidhlig a bhruidhinn. Tha an cleasaiche Beth Frieden às na Stàitean Aonaichte a’ còmhradh ri Joy anns an stiùidio, agus tha Calum MacIlleathain air turas fasanta a’ breabadh mu chuairt na Hearadh na dhòigh eug-samhail fhèin. Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds. Joy Dunlop guides us through the next steps to speak Gaelic. Actor Beth Frieden from the United States chats to Joy in the studio, and Calum Maclean weaves around the Isle of Harris in his own inimitable style. Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Tha an cleasaiche, a tha a-nis na dealbhaiche cruthachail thaighean, Erica Mhoireasdan, a’ gabhail sgrìob tron Ghàidhealtachd ‘s na h-Eileanan. Le taic bho luchd-ciùird, tha i a’ lorg dhòighean ùra air seann rumanan a thoirt beò. Actress turned interior designer, Erica Morrison, takes us on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers she finds new ideas for designing old spaces. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: An t-Eilean/The Island
programme.desc: With the evidence at the sheiling matching Sir Douglas’s new account of the night, DCI Halim is set on wrapping up the case. But Kat can’t let her theory go - Sir Douglas is convincing, but Kat’s sure it isn’t the full story. Meanwhile, Kat starts to suspect that the youngest son Ruaraidh’s guarded behaviour at the sheiling yesterday was concealing something. In the hills above, she finds charred remains of what appears to be Lady Mary’s diary, and excerpts that hint at a deep betrayal in the family. Leis an fhianais aig an àirigh agus cunntas Sir Douglas mun oidhche ’ud ’a’ freagairt air a chèile, tha DCI Halim riaraichte a’ chùis a dhùnadh. Ach cha leig Kat seachad a beachd – nach e an sgeulachd shlàn a th’ aig Sir Douglas. Tha Kat cuideachd amharasach gun robh Ruaraidh a’ cleith rudeigin aig an àirigh an-dè. Tha i a’ faighinn lorg air pìosan loisgte leabhar-là Lady Mary air a’ bheinn, le criomagan pàipeir ag innse gur dòcha gun deach cuideigin san teaghlach a mhealladh. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: ’S e Lite am bracaist as fheàrr le Abigail airson a thoirt air falbh. Ach chan eil càil sìmplidh mun dòigh a th’ aicese air a dhèanamh. Tha i ga lìonadh le Ùbhlan, Caineal agus Siorap Mhaplais, agus e a’ cur Crumbail Ùbhlan na cuimhne. Abigail’s favourite takeaway breakfast is porridge. Her version is no simple dish, though, and contains apples, cinnamon and maple syrup to remind her of apple crumble. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Tha Loch Laomainn a’ tàladh na mìltean luchd-turais gach bliadhna agus anns an earrann seo bithidh Coinneach MacFhraing nam measg, a’ falbh le bòrd agus ràmh air an astair bho Bhaile MoThatha gu Àird Laoigh. Fo sgàil feadhainn dha na beanntan is àghmhoire an Alba, cuiridh e a dhruim ris an eallach, a’ spàrn an aghaidh fìor dhroch shìde, agus a’ cadal fo chanabhas air eilean beag an deis-meadhan na Locha. Loch Lomond attracts thousands of visitors every year and in this episode, Coinneach MacFhraing joins their numbers attempting to paddle the vast distance between Balmaha and Ardlui. In the shadow of some of Scotland’s most imposing mountains, he pushes the limits of his endurance, contends with extreme weather, and spends a night on a miniature island in the middle of the loch. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Na Sgiobairean mu Dheireadh/The Last Captains
programme.desc: Tha Adam a’ sireadh èisg mhòra ann an oidhirp a sheusan a shàbhaladh, fhad ’s a tha imrich Steven a’ togail cheistean mu sheasmhachd an eilein – agus cò a bhios air fhàgail gus a chumail a’ dol. Adam chases giants to save his season, while Steven’s departure sparks questions about the islands’ future and who is left to carry it on. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Mary Ann and Lucy hunt the 'good for you' plants and those that definitely aren’t.

programme.title: Atlantis: Una niña con cualquier otro nombre
programme.sub-title: Una niña con cualquier otro nombre

programme.title: Atlantis: Un chico sin consecuencias
programme.desc: Después de cruzarse con un joven noble, Jasón y sus amigos se encuentran a merced del rey Minos, quien declara que Poseidón decidirá su destino: se convertirán en saltadores de toros.

programme.title: Atlantis: Giro del destino
programme.desc: Mientras cazan en las montañas, los niños se topan con un bebé abandonado. Jasón rescata al bebé, pero este acto caritativo tiene implicaciones de gran alcance.

programme.title: Atlantis: Mentiras piadosas
programme.desc: Cuando un mensajero trae noticias inesperadas de fuera de la ciudad, Ariadna le pide a Jasón que la ayude. Sin embargo, abandonar la ciudadela sin levantar sospechas parece una tarea insuperable.

programme.title: Atlantis: El canto de las sirenas
programme.desc: Desesperado por ganarse el corazón de Medusa, Hércules visita a una poderosa bruja, Circe. Los eventos toman un giro malévolo cuando Hércules se da cuenta de que ha desatado un encantamiento tóxico.

programme.title: Atlantis: Las reglas de compromiso

programme.title: Atlantis: Las furias

programme.title: Atlantis: Caja de Pandora

programme.title: Atlantis: El precio de la esperanza
programme.desc: Los chicos corren por sus vidas cuando se convierten en presas de una brutal persecución. Su coraje se pone a prueba hasta el límite, hasta que llega un salvavidas de una fuente inesperada.

programme.title: Atlantis: Dolores de hambre

programme.title: Atlantis: Tocado por los Dioses - Parte 1

programme.title: Atlantis: Tocado por los Dioses - Parte 2

programme.title: Money for Nothing
programme.desc: In Buckinghamshire, Sarah Moore sifts through boots full of rubbish at Beaconsfield Recycling Centre in the hope of finding three gems amongst the junk. programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael boards the Eurostar at London’s St Pancras International, bound for the Belgian capital, Brussels. In the city centre’s sumptuous Theatre Royal, he learns how an impassioned opera performance led to revolution on the streets and the birth of an independent nation. Travelling by tram to the residential district of Saint Gilles, Michael discovers the Belgian origins of art nouveau at the elegant house of architect Victor Horta. Finishing his first day at the headquarters of Nato, opened in 1967, he recalls his time as defence secretary and enjoys a private viewing of its impressive archive.

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo’s Belgian rail journey continues in the Dutch speaking region of Flanders. In Antwerp, he discovers the city's historic multibillion-pound diamond industry and drops in at the workshop of an expert. Just outside the city, Michael boards the Dendermonde to Puurs Heritage Railway, run by volunteers, and gets a chance to drive one of its 1950s diesel engines. Heading to Belgium’s third city, Ghent, Michael visits the magnificent cathedral and marvels at a 15th-century Van Eyck masterpiece, the Adoration of the Mystic Lamb, the most stolen painting in the world.

programme.title: Animal Park
programme.desc: The keepers make an exciting discovery in the emu barn - a clutch of eggs. Could the park finally get its first emu chick? The male emu is supposed to sit on the eggs, but so far this dad hasn't got the memo. Will this year be any different? The keepers are doing everything they can to help the potential parents, but they aren’t keeping their eggs in one basket - they’ve hatched another plan. Some of the eggs have been put in incubators, and there are promising signs. Elsewhere, it’s touch-and-go again with the rock hyrax babies. Earlier in the series, the keepers were concerned about some lumps on the mum, but now they have another worry - the adult male is attacking the babies. The keepers must quickly find out why. Will harmony ever be restored to this family? Also, Kate gets the chance to observe an incredible wild visitor to the park – a white-tailed sea eagle – and Jean Johansson helps out with a moth survey.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Flog it! comes from Chiddingstone Castle in Kent. Antiques experts Thomas Plant and Adam Partridge find some fascinating antiques and collectibles to take to auction. Paul Martin visits Chartwell House, home of Sir Winston Churchill, to uncover the real man behind the politician.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, former winners Jimi Famurewa, Harriet Kemsley, Colin Murray and Sara Pascoe take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall House of Champions winner being crowned on Friday. Will they opt for the House of Games golden cowboy hat, or instead go for the must-have golden wheelie luggage?

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo’s railway adventure reaches Rennes, capital of Brittany. At the Lycee Emile Zola, he hears how, in 1899, the school was used as a military court for the second trial of Alfred Dreyfus, an army captain who was twice wrongfully convicted of spying for Germany. He finds the story of racism, injustice, establishment cover-up and freedom of the press all too familiar to modern ears. Rennes’s new generation driverless metro speeds Michael across the city to the giant Stellantis car factory, where Michael joins a quality control inspection in a car that’s hot off the production line. In the historic walled citadel of St Malo, he traces the voyages of the 16th century explorer Jacques Cartier, who claimed Canada for France. Climbing the steps of Mont-Saint-Michel, Michael reflects on the layers of history evident in the abbey’s architecture and many uses over the centuries.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Actors, lifelong friends and stars of the classic 70s mods and rockers cult movie Quadrophenia, Leslie Ash and Phil Daniels exchange their scooters for a stand-out 1950s pink Cadillac and swap the streets of Brighton for the country lanes around Lincolnshire. Joining them for the ride are antiques experts Phil Serrell and Serhat Ahmet. This iconic quartet rock'n'roll their way through the local antique shops, before finding out about Lincolnshire's star-studded history as home to the world's first music festival. Both Leslie and Phil are self-proclaimed lovers of vintage, so whose pre-existing knowledge, as well as expert guidance, will help them be victorious at auction?

programme.title: Best of - Mittermeiers Lucky Punch Comedy Club
programme.desc: Best-of - Michael Mittermeier hat mit dem "Lucky Punch Comedy Club" in München einen Szenetreff des Humors geschaffen. Als Gastgeber lädt er dorthin sowohl etablierte Comedy-Stars als auch vielversprechende Nachwuchstalente ein, die mit ihren Stand-ups gemeinsam das Publikum mitreißen. Anlässlich der dritten Staffel ist es Zeit zurückzublicken und die Highlights der vergangenen Jahre in eine Sendung zu packen. In diesem Best-of ein Rückblick auf die 1. Staffel des TV-Formats. Michael Mittermeier hat sich in das Archiv des Lucky Punch Comedy Clubs begeben und die lustigsten Stand-Ups und absoluten Lieblingsmomente des Publikums zusammengestellt. Der "Godfather" der Comedy wird diese besondere ...

programme.title: Dahoam is Dahoam
programme.desc: Der Beziehungspfeffer - Die Sendung erzählt Geschichten aus dem fiktiven oberbayerischen Dorf Lansing, wo Tradition, Gemeinschaft und dörflicher Alltag eng miteinander verwoben sind. Im Zentrum stehen die Familien und Bewohner, deren humorvolle, herzliche und manchmal konfliktreiche Erlebnisse den Charme der Serie ausmachen. Schauplätze wie der Brunnerwirt, der Dorfplatz oder die Werkstatt bilden den vertrauten Rahmen, in dem Beziehungen wachsen, alte Werte gepflegt und neue Herausforderungen gemeistert werden. So vermittelt die Serie ein Gefühl von Heimat.

programme.title: Wir in Bayern - Das Schönste aus 2025
programme.desc: Wir in Bayern - Das Schönste aus 2025 - Heute: Heimatgeschichten: Adrians Gschichtla: Steingraeber Klavierfabrik Zahnmedizin: Zahngesundheit im Fokus: Antworten auf spannende Fragen Rezept: Zweierlei Schwarzwurzeln mit Matcha-Hirse Zu Gast sind Barbara Friedrich und Natia Giorgidze vom Projekt "Wohnen für Hilfe". Werner Koslowski kocht zweierlei Schwarzwurzeln mit Matcha-Hirse. Heimatforscher Dr. Adrian Rossner hat sich in einer Manufaktur umgeschaut, die Klaviere und Flügel herstellt. Außerdem berichtet "Wir in Bayern" über zerbrechliche Glaskunst und Ranger im Naturpark Hirschwald. In den Sommerferien blickt "Wir in Bayern" zurück auf die schönsten Momente aus dem Jahr 2025. Es gibt ein Wiedersehen mit inspirierenden Gästen ...

programme.title: Frankenschau aktuell
programme.desc: Frankenschau aktuell - Heute: Geplanter Umbau: Existenznot auf dem Nürnberger Hauptmarkt Falsche Tierliebe: Explosionsartige Waschbär-Vermehrung in Würzburg Wohlige Atmosphäre: Bamberger Buchhändler pflegt die Liebe zum Lesen Die Sendung berichtet werktags über das Geschehen in Ober-, Mittel- und Unterfranken. Täglich ist das Team in der Region unterwegs, um die wichtigsten Nachrichten aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Gesellschaft und Kultur aufzugreifen und verständlich aufzubereiten. Die Sendung bietet einen kompakten Überblick über aktuelle Entwicklungen und ordnet diese ein. Ergänzt wird das Programm durch Hintergrundberichte, Reportagen und Stimmen aus der Bevölkerung. Zudem rückt sie auch besondere regionale ...

programme.title: Abendschau - Der Süden
programme.desc: Abendschau - Der Süden - Die Sendung berichtet von Montag bis Freitag über aktuelle Ereignisse, Menschen und Entwicklungen aus Bayern. Das Regionalmagazin greift Themen aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Kultur und Sport auf und zeigt, was die Menschen im Freistaat bewegt. Ob kommunale Herausforderungen, gesellschaftliche Debatten, besondere Freizeitangebote oder spannende Geschichten aus dem Alltag - die Sendung bietet einen vielfältigen Blick auf den Süden Bayerns. Mit Reportagen, Hintergrundberichten und Interviews informiert sie über regionale Themen und ihre Bedeutung vor Ort.

programme.title: Space Night
programme.desc: Space Night - Heute: The Blue Planet Die Sendung nimmt die Zuschauerinnen und Zuschauer mit auf eine faszinierende Reise durch das Universum. Eindrucksvolle Aufnahmen und wissenschaftlich fundierte Animationen machen ferne Galaxien, Sterne und kosmische Phänomene erlebbar. Grundlage sind die Erkenntnisse modernster Observatorien und Teleskope, die mit hochentwickelter Technik immer tiefere Einblicke in das Weltall ermöglichen. Die Sendung verbindet anschaulich die jahrtausendealte Faszination für die Astronomie mit den neuesten Ergebnissen der Weltraumforschung und lädt dazu ein, die unendlichen Weiten des Kosmos zu entdecken.

programme.title: Corporate: Firmen-Klausur
programme.desc: Auf der Firmen-Klausur von Hampton DeVille bringen Business-Gurus Matt bei, wie man selbstsicherer wird. Jake findet Liebe bei einer Networking-Party.

programme.title: Corporate: Casual Friday
programme.desc: Matt und Jake haben Mühe, einen Kollegen zu überzeugen, am Casual Friday ein Hemd zu tragen, und Christian bemüht sich, mit einer Gruppe von Megakirchen einen Handel abzuschließen.

programme.title: Corporate: Das lange Meeting
programme.desc: John und Kate müssen die Leitung eines Meetings übernehmen, als Christian einen Anruf erhält. Sie schließen das Personal ohne ihre Handys im Konferenzraum ein, bis sie mit dem Brainstorming fertig sind.

programme.title: Corporate: Die Gesellschaft von morgen
programme.desc: Während die Mitarbeiter besessen von einer hochkarätigen TV-Serie sind, widersteht Jake ihren Versuchen, ihn dazu zu bringen, sie ebenfalls anzusehen. In Matts Leben passiert indessen auf unheimliche Weise das Gleiche wie in der Serie.

programme.title: Corporate: Wochenende
programme.desc: John drängt Jake und Matt, ihm zu helfen, eine Standuhr in sein Apartment zu bringen, und sabotiert damit ihre Wochenendpläne.

programme.title: Corporate: Tag der Erinnerung
programme.desc: Matt bewältigt sein Familientrauma, indem er sich in die Büro-Weihnachtsfeier stürzt, Christian hinterfragt sein Weltbild, und Jake zieht in Erwägung, die Firma zu verlassen.

programme.title: Corporate: Mattchiavelli und der Detektiv
programme.desc: Es kommt Unruhe auf, als die Mitarbeiter bei Hampton DeVille erfahren, dass kontrolliert wird, wie oft sie ihre Schreibtische verlassen.

programme.title: Corporate: Labor Day
programme.desc: Matt und Jake sind am Labor Day im Büro und begehen eine Dummheit. Doch sie müssen feststellen, dass sie nicht die Einzigen vor Ort sind.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hundert Kandidaten stehen bereit, um die Burg von Takeshi zu stürmen. Sie müssen das turbulente Tauziehen überstehen und beweisen, dass sie das Zeug dazu haben, die Leibgarde zu besiegen.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Brandneue Kandidaten machen sich auf den Weg zur Burg. Macht euch bereit für Nervenkitzel, Pannen und einen Haufen durchnässter Shorts, wenn die Kandidaten auf den Fliegenpilz und die Trittsteine stoßen. Schaffen sie es zum Finalspiel?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Der General hat eine Frauen-Armee zusammengestellt, die sich den Weg zu Takeshis Burg bahnt. Sie müssen sich durchs Frühstück mampfen und gegen Sumoringer kämpfen. Aber haben sie genug Frauenpower, um Takeshi zu besiegen?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Der General hat fünfzig Paare versammelt, die in ihre Siebenmeilensteinstiefel schlüpfen müssen, um die Burg zu erreichen. Zudem müssen sie sich beim Tauziehen beweisen. Welche Paare schaffen es zum Finalspiel?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Der General versammelt erneut hundert Kandidaten, die die Malzeit, das Frühstück und die Fallgrube überwinden müssen, bevor sie die Burg von Takeshi stürmen können. Hat einer von ihnen das Zeug dazu?

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Streiche

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences. In this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging "AI tourism" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc: Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy. We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations. One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI. #SummerDavos2026

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. In this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration "weaponized" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested. The Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure. From Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows?

programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. In this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration "weaponized" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested. The Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure. From Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows?

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences. In this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging "AI tourism" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Taste of Home
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May eat their way down memory lane across virtual space and different time zones, and embark on a culinary journey at their birthplace. Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna and introduces Austria's long-lasting coffeehouse culture to Tianran, who also joins her virtually for an evening with friends and food the traditional Viennese way. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood. His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoxing
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in the historic water town of Shaoxing, famed for its yellow wine. Traversing its canals by boat, Tianran discovers why it's said there are 10,000 bridges in Shaoxing, before enjoying the freshest catch of the day. But as it turns out, Shaoxing's climate is also perfect for fermentation, leading to a wide array of unique local foods that can sometimes be both smelly and delicious – and at other times, downright unforgettable!

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-4 Medieval Combat
programme.desc: Episode 4 centres on Shanghai, where Eastern and Western martial traditions meet in surprising ways. Kleber visits local practitioners of Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA), trying German and Italian longsword techniques first-hand and seeing how Chinese enthusiasts innovate by combining European swordsmanship with ancient Chinese military manuals. The episode also follows the rise of BUHURT, a European-style armored combat sport now gaining traction in China, featuring locally made traditional Chinese armour in intense full-contact bouts. Through Kleber’s own multicultural martial arts studio and the city’s everyday East-West blend, the episode shows Shanghai as a global hub, a place where classical martial arts find new life and cross-cultural practices thrive.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon – one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: Face-changing wonder boy
programme.desc: Face-changing is an ancient Chinese performance art that is a component of Sichuan opera. Hu Yibo, 13, learned the act from his grandfather and other experienced masters. Dressed in brightly-colored costumes and while changing from one mask to another in just the blink of an eye, Yibo skillfully swipes open a fan to hide his "magical" movements. As a young inheritor, he undertakes daily training to perfect his skill set in the hope of becoming a master one day.

programme.title: Qingdao: The Jade Island
programme.desc: To boost Qingdao’s international‑oriented publicity and build its profile as an international tourist city, this episode takes us to Qingdao. Through three segments‑‑Modern Qingdao, Historic Qingdao and Internationalized Qingdao, we showcase the diverse facets of this charming city.

programme.title: Living Arts of Huizhou
programme.desc: This is Huangshan in eastern China. In this city, you’ll encounter one of China’s most traditional building styles: Hui-style architecture. How does Hui style set this region apart? What’s life like for people living in these houses? With these questions in mind, we’re embarking on a journey to decode Hui-style architecture.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.3
programme.desc: Join Tianran He on a high-speed train to Shigatse, gateway to the Himalayas and home to Mount Qomolangma, the world’s highest peak. As the city with the most land ports in Xizang, Shigatse serves as a key corridor to South Asia. Here, Tianran samples breakfast at a bustling local teahouse and experiences monastic life at the vast Tashilunpo Monastery. He then visits an agricultural park where tropical crops thrive against the odds of the alpine plateau, before discovering pulu — a traditional Tibetan textile now earning global acclaim.

programme.title: Shenzhen：When Travel meets Technology
programme.desc: In the second episode of the Shenzhen series, we adopt high-tech aerial shooting and follow the host on a city tour, letting audiences experience Shenzhen’s vigorous development, lush ecological scenery and cutting-edge technological strength.

In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon – one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: Face-changing wonder boy
programme.desc: Face-changing is an ancient Chinese performance art that is a component of Sichuan opera. Hu Yibo, 13, learned the act from his grandfather and other experienced masters. Dressed in brightly-colored costumes and while changing from one mask to another in just the blink of an eye, Yibo skillfully swipes open a fan to hide his "magical" movements. As a young inheritor, he undertakes daily training to perfect his skill set in the hope of becoming a master one day.

programme.title: Qingdao: The Jade Island
programme.desc: To boost Qingdao’s international‑oriented publicity and build its profile as an international tourist city, this episode takes us to Qingdao. Through three segments‑‑Modern Qingdao, Historic Qingdao and Internationalized Qingdao, we showcase the diverse facets of this charming city.

programme.title: Living Arts of Huizhou
programme.desc: This is Huangshan in eastern China. In this city, you’ll encounter one of China’s most traditional building styles: Hui-style architecture. How does Hui style set this region apart? What’s life like for people living in these houses? With these questions in mind, we’re embarking on a journey to decode Hui-style architecture.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.3
programme.desc: Join Tianran He on a high-speed train to Shigatse, gateway to the Himalayas and home to Mount Qomolangma, the world’s highest peak. As the city with the most land ports in Xizang, Shigatse serves as a key corridor to South Asia. Here, Tianran samples breakfast at a bustling local teahouse and experiences monastic life at the vast Tashilunpo Monastery. He then visits an agricultural park where tropical crops thrive against the odds of the alpine plateau, before discovering pulu — a traditional Tibetan textile now earning global acclaim.

programme.title: Shenzhen：When Travel meets Technology
programme.desc: In the second episode of the Shenzhen series, we adopt high-tech aerial shooting and follow the host on a city tour, letting audiences experience Shenzhen’s vigorous development, lush ecological scenery and cutting-edge technological strength.

programme.title: Face-changing wonder boy
programme.desc: Face-changing is an ancient Chinese performance art that is a component of Sichuan opera. Hu Yibo, 13, learned the act from his grandfather and other experienced masters. Dressed in brightly-colored costumes and while changing from one mask to another in just the blink of an eye, Yibo skillfully swipes open a fan to hide his "magical" movements. As a young inheritor, he undertakes daily training to perfect his skill set in the hope of becoming a master one day.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-4 Medieval Combat
programme.desc: Episode 4 centres on Shanghai, where Eastern and Western martial traditions meet in surprising ways. Kleber visits local practitioners of Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA), trying German and Italian longsword techniques first-hand and seeing how Chinese enthusiasts innovate by combining European swordsmanship with ancient Chinese military manuals. The episode also follows the rise of BUHURT, a European-style armored combat sport now gaining traction in China, featuring locally made traditional Chinese armour in intense full-contact bouts. Through Kleber’s own multicultural martial arts studio and the city’s everyday East-West blend, the episode shows Shanghai as a global hub, a place where classical martial arts find new life and cross-cultural practices thrive.

programme.title: Foodwise: Haikou
programme.desc: Welcome to Haikou, also known as the Coconut City! Join Tianran He in experiencing the unique culinary culture and urban character of this tropical paradise. From light and sweet coconut chicken hotpot to refreshing herbal desserts and spicy rice soup - a local favourite, every bite tells the story of the city's laid-back charm and beauty. We'll explore everything from Haikou's winding alleys and mangrove forests, to the culture of its southeast Asian diaspora, so come and discover this magical destination with us.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan’s four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-5 Xingyi Quan
programme.desc: In Episode 5, Kleber travels to Shanxi, the birthplace of Xingyi Quan. He follows Master Cao Bing, a traditional Xingyi Quan teacher and modern combat coach, from Taiyuan’s noodle shops to Pingyao’s ancient streets, and from centuries-old vinegar breweries to Guandi temples, exploring Xingyi Quan’s deep links to Shanxi’s merchant culture and history. Master Cao breaks down the core principles of the “Five Elements and Twelve Forms”, and shows in his modern gym how techniques found in Muay Thai and Jiu-Jitsu can be integrated without losing Xingyi Quan’s philosophical core, guided by the mindset of taking only what is essential. Set against ancient sites such as Yongle Palace, this episode shows how true inner strength is like traditional timber architecture: stable, balanced, and built from within.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 1
programme.desc: Nanjing, an ancient city that served as the capital of six imperial dynasties, stands as a testament to China's long-standing history and rich culture. From its Porcelain Tower - one of the Seven Wonders of the Middle Ages, to its grand city walls and ancient palaces, join us on a voyage across time to experience the echoes of history in Nanjing's storied bricks.

programme.title: Wenzhou
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Wenzhou, southeast China — a city famed for its self-made millionaires. Here he meets the first Chinese shoemaker to expand overseas, and hears the stories of other local entrepreneurs. Along the way, he samples traditional snacks, visits some of China’s oldest lighthouses, and enjoys an evening of Ou Opera. He also learns the craft of papermaking, before heading into the hills to soak in hot springs and wander across ancient covered bridges.

programme.title: B-girl's power moves
programme.desc: Meet Gao Ya, a 10-year-old girl from Fuqing, Fujian, who goes by the stage name Gao Xing, which means to be happy. She started her break-dancing journey when she was five and has been practicing non-stop ever since. Now as a rising star in her dance squad, she has unlocked many new moves and is ready to take her skill set one step higher.

programme.title: Beijing Trough Art
programme.desc: When it comes to Beijing’s art, you may picture the Forbidden City and ancient porcelain pieces. In fact, Beijing hosts numerous outstanding modern‑art museums, whose buildings are works of art in their own right. Especially in pivotal period,

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: "When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life."

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He travels to Shannan, the cradle of Tibetan culture. Nestled in the gentlest valley of the Yarlung Zangbo River, this is where the first Tibetan king rose to power, the first palace in Xizang was built, and many other “firsts” in Xizang’s history began. Tianran visits Yamdrok Lake, one of Xizang’s three sacred lakes, where a paragliding base is taking shape. He then learns the art of Tibetan opera, joins rangers on a mission to track the elusive Tibetan red deer, and ends the day with a rejuvenating soak in a village revitalized by hot spring tourism.

programme.title: Exploring Beijing’s Backyard
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the beautiful scenery of Beijing suburbs which is usually ignored by the public. Through self-driving tour, the representative tourism resources in the north of Beijing: Yanqing, Huairou and Miyun are involved, from the scenic spots, food to accommodation. The contents include "Mini Three Gorges" Longqing Valley, "Unique Water Great Wall": Huanghuacheng and "Northern Jiangnan" : Gubei Water Town.
